sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Interpreter: Main Execution Loop
sub_graphs.description: Models the core interpreter loop that fetches, decodes, and executes opcodes

nodes.label: EVM Running
nodes.description: EVM is in running state with pc < len(code)

nodes.label: Fetch Opcode
nodes.description: Reads opcode byte at evm.code[evm.pc]

nodes.label: Decode Opcode
nodes.description: Converts byte to Ops enum value

nodes.label: Opcode Decoded
nodes.description: Valid opcode has been decoded and ready for execution

nodes.label: Trace OpStart
nodes.description: Calls evm_trace with OpStart for debugging

nodes.label: Dispatch to Handler
nodes.description: Calls op_implementation[op](evm) to execute opcode

nodes.label: Trace OpEnd
nodes.description: Calls evm_trace with OpEnd after execution

nodes.label: Opcode Executed
nodes.description: Opcode handler has completed, PC may have advanced

nodes.label: EVM Halted
nodes.description: evm.running is False or pc >= len(code)

nodes.label: Invalid Opcode Error
nodes.description: ValueError raised when opcode byte is not valid

sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Interpreter: Error Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models the exception handling for ExceptionalHalt and Revert conditions

nodes.label: Opcode Executing
nodes.description: Opcode handler is currently running

nodes.label: Exceptional Halt Caught
nodes.description: ExceptionalHalt exception was raised during execution

nodes.label: Consume All Gas
nodes.description: Sets evm.gas_left = Uint(0)

nodes.label: Clear Output
nodes.description: Sets evm.output = b''

nodes.label: Set Error State
nodes.description: Sets evm.error = error

nodes.label: Revert Caught
nodes.description: Revert exception was raised

nodes.label: Preserve Remaining Gas
nodes.description: Gas is not consumed on revert

nodes.label: Rollback Transaction State
nodes.description: Calls rollback_transaction() to undo state changes

nodes.label: Error Finalized
nodes.description: Error handling complete, ready to return result

nodes.label: Execution Succeeded
nodes.description: No exception was raised

sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Interpreter: Message Call Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the message call handling including contract creation and regular calls

nodes.label: Message Received
nodes.description: A message call has been initiated

nodes.label: Check Stack Depth Limit
nodes.description: Validates message.depth <= STACK_DEPTH_LIMIT (1024)

nodes.label: Stack Depth Exceeded
nodes.description: Call depth exceeds 1024, raises StackDepthLimitError

nodes.label: Check if Contract Creation
nodes.description: Determines if message.target == Bytes0(b'')

nodes.label: Contract Creation Path
nodes.description: Message is creating a new contract

nodes.label: Regular Call Path
nodes.description: Message is calling an existing address

nodes.label: Check Address Collision
nodes.description: Calls account_has_code_or_nonce() to detect collision

nodes.label: Mark Account Created
nodes.description: Sets account as created and increments nonce

nodes.label: Process Message
nodes.description: Executes the EVM interpreter loop

nodes.label: Validate Contract Code
nodes.description: Rejects code starting with 0xEF prefix

nodes.label: Check Code Size Limit
nodes.description: Validates len(code) <= MAX_CODE_SIZE (0x6000)

nodes.label: Charge Code Deposit Gas
nodes.description: Charges len(code) * GAS_CODE_DEPOSIT

nodes.label: Set Contract Code
nodes.description: Commits code to account via set_code()

nodes.label: Process EOA Authorizations
nodes.description: Handles EIP-7702 authorizations from message.tx_env

nodes.label: Get Delegated Code
nodes.description: Retrieves code from delegated address if applicable

nodes.label: Message Call Complete
nodes.description: Message execution finished with result

external_entities.name: Message Caller
external_entities.description: Entity initiating the message call (EOA or contract)

sub_graphs.title: Prague EVM Interpreter: Gas Management
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas allocation, consumption, and refund mechanisms

nodes.label: Gas Allocated
nodes.description: Initial gas from message.gas is set in evm.gas_left

nodes.label: Consume Gas for Operation
nodes.description: Deducts gas cost from gas_left during opcode execution

nodes.label: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: gas_left < required gas, triggers OutOfGas error

nodes.label: Track Refund Counter
nodes.description: Accumulates refunds from SSTORE and SELFDESTRUCT

nodes.label: Execution Complete
nodes.description: Message execution finished, gas accounting needed

nodes.label: Compute Final Refund
nodes.description: Calculates actual refund as min(accumulated, gas_used/5)

nodes.label: Charge Code Deposit Gas
nodes.description: For contract creation: len(contract_code) * GAS_CODE_DEPOSIT

nodes.label: Final Gas Calculated
nodes.description: gas_left and refund_counter are finalized

ambiguities.text: The op_implementation mapping is referenced but the complete mapping of opcodes to handlers is not shown
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM opcode mapping with Prague-specific additions like EIP-7702 authorization opcodes.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when rollback_transaction fails or has no checkpoint is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rollback requires a valid checkpoint from commit_transaction, and missing checkpoint is a programming error.

ambiguities.text: The 0xEF prefix rejection for contract code is mentioned without specifying the full EIP-3541 context
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all code starting with 0xEF is rejected per EIP-3541 to reserve prefix for future EOF format.

implicit_assumptions.description: The transient_storage in message.tx_env is properly isolated per transaction and cleared between transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cross-transaction information leakage could occur through transient storage

implicit_assumptions.description: The evm_trace function has no side effects on execution state
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Tracing could interfere with EVM state, causing non-deterministic execution

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot cause unbounded recursion before hitting STACK_DEPTH_LIMIT
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stack overflow or memory exhaustion attacks could crash nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: MAX_CODE_SIZE (0x6000 = 24576 bytes) is sufficient for legitimate contracts
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Legitimate contracts exceeding this limit would fail to deploy
